bundles.name: All Included (Classic drinks + Basic Wi-Fi)
bundles.notes: Upcharge vs cruise-only is not published and varies by sailing, so the optimizer skips it until a price is known. Staff gratuities not included (beverage gratuities are). Default US fare type.

bundles.name: Have It All
bundles.notes: Signature Beverage Package (15 drinks/day up to $12), Surf Wi-Fi, specialty dinners: 1 (4-9 nights), 2 (10-20), 3 (21+); 1 is modeled. Excursion credit $100/$200/$300. $65/day for departures from summer 2027. Gratuities not stated as included.

bundles.name: Princess Plus
bundles.notes: 15 drinks/day up to $15 each, 1-device Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, 4 casual meals. $75 on Sun and Star Princess; +$5 if bought onboard.

bundles.name: Princess Premier
bundles.notes: Unlimited drinks up to $20, 4-device Wi-Fi, unlimited specialty dining, crew appreciation, excursion credit, photos. $110 on Sun and Star Princess.

lines.name: Carnival Cruise Line
lines.notes: CHEERS! $69.95 + 20% pre-cruise; Bottomless Bubbles $11.99 + 20%; Premium (streaming) Wi-Fi $25.50/day pre-cruise. Carnival moves drink and Wi-Fi packages to per-sailing pricing from 2026-12-01. Steakhouse about $52 incl. gratuity.

lines.name: Celebrity Cruises
lines.notes: Classic drinks ~$90 + 20% service (third-party, Sept 2026); Basic Wi-Fi ~$20/day; specialty dinners $58-67 + 20%. Soft-drink package price not found.

lines.name: Cunard
lines.notes: Beverage Collection about $75-85.50/day depending on voyage length (third-party, 2026); Wi-Fi from $18/day. New 2026 Signature Packages (~$75/day) bundle drinks, Wi-Fi and dining credit; contents vary, not modeled.

lines.name: Holland America Line
lines.notes: Signature Beverage Package from $54.95 + 18% (third-party, undated). Wi-Fi $30.99/day per Holland America's blog comparison. Pinnacle Grill about $52 (third-party).

lines.name: Princess Cruises
lines.notes: Standalone Plus Beverage Package reported at $64.99/day incl. service charge (another source says $77.99). MedallionNet $24.99/day. Crown Grill about $55 + 20%.

lines.name: Royal Caribbean
lines.notes: Deluxe Beverage Package is priced per sailing (~$56-105 + 18% in 2026 reports); midpoint used. VOOM $16.99-30.99/device/day (official guide). Specialty: Chops $69.99, Giovanni's $54.99 (2024) + 18%.

lines.name: Seabourn
lines.notes: All-inclusive: drinks (most wines and spirits), Wi-Fi, gratuities and dining are in the fare, so add-on prices are not needed.

tiers.name: Cloud 9 Spa staterooms
tiers.notes: Unlimited thermal suite and thalassotherapy pool, priority spa booking. Sold as interior, ocean view, balcony and suite. Ship list from a truncated source; other ships may also have them.

tiers.name: Family Harbor staterooms
tiers.notes: Family Harbor Lounge with continental breakfast, snacks, games; kids 11 and under dine free at some venues.

tiers.name: Havana staterooms
tiers.notes: Private Havana pool area. All guests in the cabin must be 12 or older. Havana suites pay the suite gratuity ($19).

tiers.name: Suites (Junior, Grand, Ocean & Captain's)
tiers.notes: Priority check-in, boarding, luggage delivery, tender and debarkation.

tiers.name: Excel suites (Excel class only)
tiers.notes: Unlimited Loft 19 access (secluded top-deck area with pool and cabanas, priority cabana booking), dedicated concierge line, guaranteed specialty dining times. Reported extras: Bottomless Bubbles soda package and laundry; laundry terms unconfirmed.

tiers.name: Veranda (incl. Infinite Veranda)
tiers.notes: Edge-class Infinite Verandas: 131-184 sq ft plus 42-45 sq ft enclosed balcony area (TPG figures conflict).

tiers.name: Concierge Class
tiers.notes: Veranda layout + dedicated concierge, welcome lunch, priority dining/excursion support. Priority boarding: sources conflict (left unknown).

tiers.name: AquaClass
tiers.notes: Blu restaurant (AquaClass-exclusive), unlimited thermal suite (SEA Thermal Suite on Edge; Persian Garden on Solstice/Millennium), spa concierge. Size range varies by class.

tiers.name: The Retreat: Sky, Aqua Sky, Celebrity & Signature Suites
tiers.notes: Luminae (suite-only restaurant), Retreat Lounge (Michael's Club on Solstice/Eclipse/Reflection), butler, Premium drinks + Premium Wi-Fi. Laundry and unlimited specialty dining start at Royal Suite. Aqua Sky Suites also get thermal suite access. Retreat Sundeck not on Solstice, Eclipse, Reflection, Constellation, Infinity.

tiers.name: The Retreat: Royal Suite & above (Royal, Penthouse, Edge Villa, Iconic)
tiers.notes: Adds unlimited specialty dining (dinner nightly, lunch on sea days), complimentary laundry + unlimited pressing, unlimited Premium drinks, personalized minibar, thermal suite. Edge Villa and Iconic Suite exist on Edge-class only.

tiers.name: Britannia Club
tiers.notes: Dedicated Britannia Club restaurant with single-seating dining. No Grills Lounge or Terrace.

tiers.name: Princess Grill suites
tiers.notes: Princess Grill restaurant (reserved table), Grills Lounge with afternoon tea, Grills Terrace. Priority boarding, concierge and laundry not confirmed (official Grills page unavailable when checked).

tiers.name: Queens Grill suites
tiers.notes: Queens Grill restaurant, Grills Lounge and Terrace, dedicated butler and steward, in-suite dining from the Queens Grill menu.

tiers.name: Vista & Signature Suites
tiers.notes: Official suite amenities list only a no-host mini-bar, binoculars and pillow choice; no concierge, laundry or priority access.

tiers.name: Neptune Suites
tiers.notes: Neptune Lounge with concierge, complimentary laundry, pressing and dry cleaning, priority check-in, disembarkation and tender boarding. Club Orange private dining only on Pinnacle-class ships; elsewhere priority dining-room seating.

tiers.name: Pinnacle Suites (Pinnacle class only)
tiers.notes: Neptune perks plus a larger suite with separate living area; Club Orange and Pinnacle Grill breakfast.

tiers.name: Reserve Collection mini-suites
tiers.notes: Reserve dining area with expedited seating, welcome wine, canapés on request, priority disembarkation. No lounge, no laundry.

tiers.name: Reserve Collection suites
tiers.notes: Reserve dining, Concierge Lounge, Suite Experience manager, complimentary laundry and professional cleaning (same-day express extra), mini-bar setup, private breakfast venue, priority disembarkation. Priority boarding not stated on the official page.

tiers.name: Sanctuary Collection (select suites and staterooms)
tiers.notes: Princess Premier is bundled in: premium drinks, unlimited specialty dining, Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, room service. Private spaces and Sanctuary Restaurant. Includes some non-suite staterooms. Sky and Enchanted Princess join in December 2026.

tiers.name: Ocean View
tiers.notes: Ultra Spacious Ocean View (about 319 sq ft) sleeps up to 6.

tiers.name: Balcony
tiers.notes: About 182 sq ft plus about 50 sq ft balcony (Symphony).

tiers.name: Sea Class: Junior Suites
tiers.notes: Priority boarding and a dedicated check-in line. Coastal Kitchen dinner only, by reservation and space permitting; no suite lounge. Coastal Kitchen exists on Oasis, Quantum and Icon class ships.

tiers.name: Sky Class: Grand, Owner's & Sky Loft suites
tiers.notes: Concierge, suite lounge with evening drinks, all-day Coastal Kitchen, suite sun deck (The Grove on Icon class). VOOM Wi-Fi for one device per person, except Sky Junior and Sunset Junior Suites. Drinks package and laundry not included.

tiers.name: Star Class: Royal Loft, Owner's Loft, Grand Loft, Ultimate Family & Villa suites
tiers.notes: Royal Genie service, Deluxe Beverage Package, VOOM Wi-Fi, specialty dining at most venues (some items extra), complimentary laundry and pressing, gratuities included (Genie tips extra). Royal Loft sleeps 6; the Ultimate Family Suite (Symphony, Wonder, Spectrum) may sleep more.

tiers.name: Veranda & Ocean View Suites
tiers.notes: All-suite ship; entry suites have a sitting area. One review says The Grill by Thomas Keller carries a cover charge; most sources say all dining is included.

tiers.name: Penthouse Suites
tiers.notes: Separate living and dining area; reported to add unlimited Stream Wi-Fi and a Nespresso machine.

tiers.name: Penthouse Spa Suites
tiers.notes: Access to the Spa Serene Area and a Spa Concierge.

tiers.name: Owner's, Signature & Wintergarden Suites
tiers.notes: Expanded in-suite bar and complimentary private car transfer (up to 50 miles); some have veranda whirlpools.
